estimate_kind: subjective engineering-completion ranges for the new practical goal
percentage_definition: Rough judgment about implementation, targeted tests and integration against PRACTICAL-GOAL.md, not checklist fraction, reliability, elapsed/remaining time or a weighted whole-OS score.

milestones.title: Preservation and practical workflow
milestones.basis: Recoverable checkpoints and source/artifact handoffs remain strong; final supported-profile delivery is still open.

milestones.title: Requests, responses and recovery
milestones.basis: Additional accepted application traffic reuses existing request paths; final negative/cancellation closure has not newly passed.

milestones.title: Execution and comparison runner
milestones.basis: Three additional accepted native behaviors and retained complete results/physical retirement extend the working execution path; final timeout/rejection coverage remains open.

milestones.title: Memory and mapping correctness
milestones.basis: Existing map/protect/unmap proof is preserved; no new final-profile ownership/restoration closure in this interval.

milestones.title: Useful C and Rust applications
milestones.basis: Useful C and real Rust std applications on the matched candidate and independent selected-suite/Linux comparison close P-M04-01 and P-M04-03; final integrated regression remains open.

milestones.title: Native lifecycle and restoration
milestones.basis: The previously credited second native stop/release remains preserved; no additional final-profile lifecycle completion is credited.

milestones.title: Processes, threads and used syscalls
milestones.basis: Accepted mixed Rust/std application adds six worker lifetimes across three overlap windows with checked synchronization/publication behavior; process creation/exec/wait remains open.

milestones.title: Used FPU/vector state
milestones.basis: Current492 has accepted native AVX/thread/signal chain plus NULL-fpstate guaranteed x87 FINIT reset; full used-feature/final-profile coverage and broader reset claims remain open.

milestones.title: Native modules and interfaces
milestones.basis: Existing matched modules preserved; reviewed IHK host-tool/build preparation is not a newly accepted module artifact.

milestones.title: Rust and assembly integration
milestones.basis: INTEGRATION ONLY: eight selected Rust bodies production/default-link proved, seven with applicable native-chain proof. Broader live compute-C retirement remains active and unmeasured; pending scheduler port has no production/native credit.
milestones.scope_note: Integration only; not whole-kernel Rust conversion

milestones.title: Repeatable runnable build
milestones.basis: Additional successful pinned thin-image builds/default-link ABI validation demonstrate repeatable candidate preparation; final clean matched recipe replay remains open.

milestones.title: Integrated functional regression
milestones.basis: Accepted behavior set expands16 to19 with useful mixed-app, empty-file and NULL-fpstate evidence plus selected Linux comparisons; final integrated regression remains open.

milestones.title: Bounded repeatability and stress
milestones.basis: Final-profile two boots/ten cycles/100 launches/60-minute mixed session has not newly passed; no uplift for preparation or unrelated diagnostic vectors.

milestones.title: Practical delivery
milestones.basis: New checkpoints preserve runnable next commands; final delivery/capability statement and final correctness review remain open.

exclusions: Pending IHK host-module build is not counted as completed.
Scheduler local216-case parity is not production/native retirement and gets no completion credit.
M09 range continues the historical integration-only estimate; full compute-C retirement percentage is unmeasured.
